fly_dsi — FLYVISION tuning op

• Data kinds: signal → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fly_dsi(responses, angles_deg) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import flyvision; flyvision.fly_dsi(responses, angles_deg), registry से लेना हो तो opsflyvision.get("fly_dsi"))

उपयोग

tuning responses से direction-selectivity index और preferred दिशा।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

A vector sum on the circle::

DSI = |sum_k r_k exp(i theta_k)| / (sum_k r_k + 1e-9)

preferred = angle(sum_k r_k exp(i theta_k))

where r_k >= 0 is the response to a stimulus moving at angle theta_k = angles_deg[k] (negatives clipped to 0).

responses: a 1-D array of responses, one per direction.

angles_deg: the stimulus directions in degrees, same length.

Returns a dict {"dsi": float, "pref_deg": float} with pref_deg in [-180, 180].

Ground truth: a response at a single direction gives dsi == 1; an isotropic response over directions evenly spanning the circle gives dsi == 0 (pinned in the tests).

Raises ValueError: a non-1-D / empty / non-finite *responses* or *angles_deg*, mismatched lengths, an array over MAX_SIGNAL_POINTS, and an all-zero *responses* (no direction tuning to report).
